Create catch target files and calibration settings from observed catch

create_target_files_catch.Rd

Sums observed catch by functional group and year, and uses the median annual catch of each group as a constant target for calibrar. Writes all the files needed to set up a catch calibration:

  • data/<Name>_catch.csv: one target time series per group, with columns Time and Catch.

  • calibration_settings_catch.csv: calibration settings for each catch target.

  • catch.txt and catch_crash.txt: R code snippets used to build the output list of the run model function, for a successful run and for a crashed run (all zeros), respectively.

Usage

create_target_files_catch(
  catch.file,
  fg.file,
  output.path = here::here("inputs"),
  dt.timeseries = 5,
  weight = 2,
  plot = FALSE
)

Arguments

catch.file

Character. Path to the observed catch CSV file. Must contain the columns Name, Code, year and catch_tons. Multiple rows per group and year (e.g. by fleet or area) are summed.

fg.file

Character. Name of the functional groups CSV file in inputs/model_configuration. Must contain the columns Code and Name.

output.path

Character. Directory where output files are written. Target files are written to its data sub-directory, which is created if needed. Default: inputs.

dt.timeseries

Integer. Number of time steps in each target time series. Default: 5.

weight

Numeric. Calibration weight given to each catch target. Default: 2.

plot

Logical. If TRUE, plots the annual catch time series of each group, with its median as a horizontal line. Default: FALSE.

Value

Invisibly, the calibration settings data frame. Called for its side effect of writing files to output.path.

Details

Fishing mortality parameters (mfc) are not created here; they are written by create_target_files_biomass.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  create_target_files_catch(
    catch.file = here::here("inputs", "PS_catch_2011-2019.csv"),
    fg.file    = "PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups_2024.csv",
    plot       = TRUE
  )
} # }
